title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 4.8
exact_target: Bound the derivative of a monic polynomial on its connected unit lemniscate. The originally proposed constant is false; the source records the stated sharp correction.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2304008 (AMR-022-4008). CC BY 4.0.

Walter K. Hayman and Edward F. Lingham, \emph{Research Problems in Function Theory}, arXiv:1809.07200, 2018. Lemniscate notation preceding Problem 4.7, Problem 4.7, Problem 4.8 and its complete Update 4.8.
